verdict.rationale: Docs say one integration covers instant bank verification (auth), balances, ownership details, and transactions. Separate balance, ownership and transaction refresh webhooks suggest each data type is pulled for the same linked account, which points to one connection feeding several data products. However, the pack never states that a single authentication session requests and grants all these data types at once; it only says "one integration." Missing for 10: explicit documentation that one session can request multiple data permissions together, evidence that adding a data product later needs no re-consent or new flow, and independent hands-on confirmation of multi-product use from one link.
